senses.sense_definition: Врач, специализирующийся на ведении беременности и принятии родов.

examples.text: Опытный <w>акушер</w> внимательно следил за состоянием здоровья будущей матери.

target_lang_translations.en: An experienced <w>obstetrician</w> carefully monitored the health of the expectant mother.

examples.text: На родах присутствовал квалифицированный <w>акушер</w> и медицинская сестра.

target_lang_translations.en: A qualified <w>obstetrician</w> and a nurse were present at the birth.

target_lang_definitions.en: A physician or medical professional who specializes in pregnancy and childbirth.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: A medical doctor specializing in the care of women during pregnancy and childbirth.
A formal or historical term for a person, often a man, who assists in childbirth.
